sources.geometry: presets/hub-locked.json AH (core, former, coil), AH_seat, vessel, vessel_wall, shaft
sources.mu_rod, Bsat_100C: presets/electromagnets-RA.json rotor.AH_rod (mu_i, Bsat_100C_T; [RH] there until the 77 datasheet is read in)
sources.Bsat_25C: not in the repository: Fair-Rite 77 datasheet-class [IR]
sources.L_AH_record: sim/magnetic_doubler.py AH['r160'] (variant (a)'s former rewound, [RH] N^2 scaling)
sources.currents: sim/ah_steady_cusp_results.json rows C_byp 0 and 22 mF; the waveforms regenerated as sim/ah_steady_cusp.py runs them
sources.naming: README.md:24 and docs/ledger/DCCREG-design-ledger.md:61 (side A below); sim/ah-steady-cusp-findings.md:9-10 (AHt = side A)
sources.RA comparison: sim/em_register_results.json ra.magnetics.a (all four windings at a 15 kV ring)

L_vs_record.note: the record's 1.01 mH is the register's 98.5 uH (variant (a), 50 turns, with rod) x (160/50)^2

G_per_AT_vs_RA.note: RA: all four windings at a 15 kV ring; the aiding cone pair adds no gradient at the centre by symmetry, so the AH alone should match per A-turn

external_field.note: axial: computed with the rods (psi = B r^2 / 2 on the far boundary); transverse: the bare estimate 2 B / G from the radial gradient G/2, the rods' transverse concentration not computed

record_basis.note: the RA run's rod field came from all four windings in one chain: the cones L_TC / L_BC (32 turns each at the same ring current) as well as the AH (sim/em_ra.py, i_turn over every turn)
